claims.statement: A coding agent can connect an authored product-possibility value prediction to scoped later consequence assessments and an explicitly authored decision review, and recover the bounded feedback alongside its prospective landscape and method precedents using existing query and producer commands.

attributes.scope: Explicit conseq: hypotheses with source_possibility and reviewed references; existing assessment supersession; visible candidate ecology and optional existing method precedent query; one actual historic case at eda01cbf with run 46089264492.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Observed source and one same-agent actual producer/query path; no automatic benefit evaluation, applicability, decision ranking, independent cognitive improvement or longitudinal advantage.

claims.statement: Agents develop a product's possibility landscape through experience of which anticipated values materialize, fail to materialize, or remain unassessed, using the evidence to revise later developmental choices rather than only recording implementation.

attributes.title: Experience-grounded possibility evaluation

alignment.basis: ADR 0038 selects reciprocal development through actual consequential experience.

ambition.basis: Adds explicit outcome-grounded evaluation of product futures, distinct from capability realization and architectural alternative review.

horizon.basis: Existing consequence hypothesis, assessment and decision review mechanisms support a bounded extension.

realization.basis: Actual run 46089264492 recovered one historical prediction and scoped assessment, generated and preflighted an agent-authored review; other candidates remain unassessed and actual benefit of this new loop is not established.

disposition_history.rationale: Too few selected possibilities had observable outcomes for an outcome loop.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection under owner's continuing self-development mandate
disposition_history.rationale: Actual detached-stewardship prediction and later outcome support a bounded reversible construction reusing the existing consequence and review mechanism.

attributes.value_hypothesis: Reconnecting a possibility's intended value with actual scoped observations and reconsideration may let later strategic choices be better informed than choices based only on realization or historical disposition.
attributes.revisit_when: A later real development decision uses, corrects or rejects a value assessment or demonstrates that the new feedback path adds no decision-relevant value; or file:src/sensemaking_skills/semantic_architecture/consequence_standing.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: A direct read of original evidence and an ordinary decision note can suffice. First case is same-agent and retrospectively normalized; most possibilities have no explicit predictions. Extra evidence structure can add burden or encourage premature value conclusions.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One bounded implemented lifecycle over real earlier sources; no measured improved selection, predictive accuracy, comparative creativity or independent longitudinal cognition.

attributes.scope: Intended contribution through source-linked feedback; not established goal achievement.
